effective_export_revision: The immutable Git commit containing this file. The registration workflow pins it by full SHA and records it in the binary provenance.
exclusions: All private Lite packaging files and bundles
Distribution manifests, private site tooling, PINs, router configuration, OAuth credentials, and local user state
parity: For the declared build inputs, every tracked blob except the two sanitization paths equals source_base_git_hash. This is intentionally not whole-source parity.
purpose: one-off native macOS Intel build only

sanitization.availability_limit: The direct Antigravity and Gemini Google OAuth flows cannot use embedded application credentials in this export. Environment-provided approved OAuth configuration remains the only supported direct configuration where the public-base code supports it; otherwise login or refresh fails explicitly.
sanitization.credential_handling: Both paths retain the already published public-base credential-safe implementation. No embedded upstream OAuth application identifiers or secrets are exported.

workflow_entrypoint: The separately reviewed default-main registration workflow checks out the caller-selected immutable effective export revision and rejects wrong source, tree, or build-input digest.
